sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: And we are counting down to chaos.
sentences.zh: 我们正在倒计时迎接混乱的到来。

sentences.en: Title 42 will officially expire in less than 18 hours.
sentences.zh: 第42条边境条款将在不到18小时后正式失效。

sentences.en: The pandemic era policy allowed the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这项大流行时期的政策允许美国

sentences.en: government to quickly expel migrants who crossed into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 政府迅速驱逐非法越境进入美国的

sentences.en: illegally.
sentences.zh: 移民。

sentences.en: After Thursday, it's going to be a free-for-all.
sentences.zh: 周四之后，情况将变得一发不可收拾。

sentences.en: For weeks, officials have feared that the end of Title 42 would create a crisis at the U.S.-Mexico border that would strain and possibly cripple America's immigration system.
sentences.zh: 几周以来，官员们一直担心第42条的终结会在美墨边境引发危机，从而使美国的移民系统不堪重负，甚至可能陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: Title 42 goes away on Thursday and migrants will be in crisis as soon as next week.
sentences.zh: 第42条将于周四废除，移民们最快下周就会陷入危机。

sentences.en: It will be a humanitarian crisis because we are not prepared.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场人道主义危机，因为我们根本没有准备好。

sentences.en: My colleague, Natalie Kichouev, has been at the border and describes what actually happened when the milestone policy came to an end.
sentences.zh: 我的同事娜塔莉·基楚耶夫一直在边境现场，她将描述这项里程碑式的政策终结时实际发生的情况。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Okay, can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 好的，你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: I can hear you.
sentences.zh: 我能听到。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: We're just pulling off to this part of the border that I'm trying to get to.
sentences.zh: 我们正开车前往我试图抵达的边境区域。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: It's super dusty.
sentences.zh: 这里灰尘太大了。

sentences.en: So, Natalie, just by way of context, it's Thursday, May 11th.
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莉，先交代一下背景，今天是5月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: You're right at the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 你就在美墨边境。

sentences.en: It's the middle of the day.
sentences.zh: 现在是中午。

sentences.en: Can you just describe exactly where you are geographically and what you're seeing?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下你所在的地理位置以及你所看到的情况吗？

sentences.en: First of all, I'm seeing the group of migrants, maybe 300 or 400 people that have gathered on the other side of the Rio Grande.
sentences.zh: 首先，我看到一群移民，大概有300到400人，聚集在格兰德河的另一边。

sentences.en: Crossing the Rio Grande, which, by the way, is not that grand at this particular part of Ciudad Juarez.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过了格兰德河，顺便说一下，在华雷斯城这一段，这条河其实并不“宏大”。

sentences.en: It's like a shallow and very crossable stream-like body of water almoSt.
sentences.zh: 它几乎就像一条浅浅的、很容易就能淌过去的溪流。

sentences.en: And they just have walked across the other side, which means they're on U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚走到了对岸，这意味着他们已经踏上了美国的

sentences.en: soil.
sentences.zh: 土地。

sentences.en: They get off the riverbank and there's this barbed wire.
sentences.zh: 他们爬上河岸，那里有铁丝网。

sentences.en: They've been going through the barbed wire, and now they are between the barbed wire and this massive border wall.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过了铁丝网，现在正处于铁丝网和那道巨大的边境墙之间。

sentences.en: That's what you might imagine.
sentences.zh: 这就是你可能想象的那样。

sentences.en: It looks like a big, very tall fence.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是一道又高又大的栅栏。

sentences.en: But they're on U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经在美国

sentences.en: soil, and so they want to turn themselves in to border officials, some of them to apply for asylum.
sentences.zh: 土地上了，所以他们想向边境官员自首，其中一些人是为了申请庇护。

sentences.en: Natalie, what does it mean for the people on the other side of this river who are successfully crossing, to some degree, to do that today?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，对于河对岸那些今天成功越境的人来说，这样做意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're hours away from this border restriction being lifted.
sentences.zh: 距离这项边境限制措施解除还有几个小时。

sentences.en: And what that means for folks is that the migration landscape in the United States is about to radically change.
sentences.zh: 对这些人来说，这意味着美国的移民格局即将发生根本性的改变。

sentences.en: They're going to be the first people, we think, depending on when border agents start processing them, to really test out what is this new system.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，他们将是第一批真正考验这套新系统的人，具体取决于边境人员何时开始处理他们的申请。

sentences.en: You know, before, under the measure, which is called Title 42, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在此之前，根据这项名为“第42条”的措施，美国

sentences.en: government could summarily expel people when they crossed illegally.
sentences.zh: 政府可以在人们非法越境时直接将他们驱逐。

sentences.en: That's no longer an option anymore, starting later tonight.
sentences.zh: 从今天深夜开始，这就不再是一个选项了。

sentences.en: Now, folks who are on U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，身处美国

sentences.en: soil are going to have to be processed.
sentences.zh: 土地上的人都必须经过处理程序。

sentences.en: It's going to take longer.
sentences.zh: 这需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: Whether or not they're actually going to get legal status, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 至于他们是否真的能获得合法身份，我们不得而知。

sentences.en: It's going to be difficult.
sentences.zh: 这将会很困难。

sentences.en: The Biden administration has put in new rules.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府已经出台了新规定。

sentences.en: And the people that I'm looking at right now are the ones who are really, we think, again, it depends on when they get across or what's really going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我眼前的这些人，我们认为他们将是第一批——当然，这取决于他们何时越境以及到底会发生什么。

sentences.en: But these are going to be the first people to kind of test it out.
sentences.zh: 但他们将是第一批尝试这套系统的人。

sentences.en: Natalie, the Biden administration has said very clearly over the past couple of days, I think as recently as earlier today on Thursday,
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，拜登政府在过去几天里说得很清楚，我想就在今天周四早些时候还提到过，

sentences.en: the border is not open and we will not let you in.
sentences.zh: 边境并没有开放，我们不会让你们进来。

sentences.en: And yet, from what you're describing, that's not really the issue.
sentences.zh: 然而，根据你的描述，这似乎并不是问题所在。

sentences.en: People are getting in.
sentences.zh: 人们正在进来。

sentences.en: They are there.
sentences.zh: 他们就在那里。

sentences.en: So how do you reconcile all that?
sentences.zh: 那么你该如何调和这些矛盾呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you know, it's true that the border isn't open.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，边境确实没有开放，这是事实。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not as if the gates were just flung wide open and people are walking through.
sentences.zh: 并不是说大门敞开，人们就能直接走进来。

sentences.en: But folks are getting on U.S.
sentences.zh: 但人们现在确实已经踏上了美国的

sentences.en: soil right now.
sentences.zh: 土地。

sentences.en: And the reality is that when Title 42 lifts later tonight, the administration is going to have to process these people one by one.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，当第42条在今晚晚些时候解除后，政府将不得不逐一处理这些人的申请。

sentences.en: But if the policy right in this moment before midnight is to summarily expel migrants who come to the border, why is this group crossing now?
sentences.zh: 但如果此时此刻午夜之前，政策仍然是直接驱逐来到边境的移民，为什么这群人现在要越境？

sentences.en: Honestly, it's impossible to know exactly why any group of migrants is crossing right now.
sentences.zh: 老实说，不可能确切知道为什么任何移民群体现在要越境。

sentences.en: We don't have any really clear sense.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何明确的头绪。

sentences.en: And there's just a lot of mixed messaging.
sentences.zh: 而且信息非常混乱。

sentences.en: So it's difficult to parse, you know, the individual rationale of each person.
sentences.zh: 所以很难分析每个人的个人动机。

sentences.en: But what we know is that over the last several days, we have seen a rush to the border and we are still seeing people crossing today.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道的是，在过去几天里，我们看到了涌向边境的人潮，而且今天仍然有人在越境。

sentences.en: And it remains to be seen what's going to happen over the next few days.
sentences.zh: 未来几天会发生什么还有待观察。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But as we've said on the show, for weeks there have been reports of a surge of people coming to the border in anticipation of this change.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们在节目中所说，几周以来一直有报道称，为了应对这一变化，大批人涌向边境。

sentences.en: Do you have any sense of how many people are at or just inside of the border right now?
sentences.zh: 你是否了解目前在边境或刚刚进入边境的人数有多少？

sentences.en: So we've been hearing that there's going to be this massive surge today on the day that this pandemic rule lifts.
sentences.zh: 我们一直听说，在这项大流行规则解除的今天，会出现大规模的激增。

sentences.en: But the reality is the numbers show that the surge is already here.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，数据显示激增已经发生了。

sentences.en: The number of encounters at the border has gone up to 11,000 a day.
sentences.zh: 边境的拦截人数已经上升到每天11,000人。

sentences.en: That's up from 6,000 a day just a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 这比几周前的每天6,000人有所增加。

sentences.en: So that's a huge increase.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的增长。

sentences.en: I mean, in effect, this thing that we were all racing for, it's already upon us.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，实际上，我们都在竞相迎接的这一刻，它已经到来了。

sentences.en: It's been happening.
sentences.zh: 它一直在发生。

sentences.en: This is the reality at the border right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前边境的现实。

sentences.en: Nellie, you have been where you are for the past week.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，你已经在那里待了一周了。

sentences.en: So describe what you have been seeing as all these migrants have arrived at the border.
sentences.zh: 那么请描述一下你所看到的这些移民抵达边境时的情景。

sentences.en: Well, you're seeing people coming in on buses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看到人们乘公共汽车而来。

sentences.en: You're seeing them coming in on planes.
sentences.zh: 你看到他们乘飞机而来。

sentences.en: And one of the most dangerous ways that they're getting here is on this train that's known as the BeaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们到达这里最危险的方式之一是乘坐一列被称为“野兽”的火车。

sentences.en: It's also known as the Train of Death because it's a really dangerous method for people to be traveling.
sentences.zh: 它也被称为“死亡之车”，因为这对人们来说是一种非常危险的旅行方式。

sentences.en: It's this massive cargo train that, you know, people risk their lives just getting on.
sentences.zh: 这是一列巨大的货运火车，你知道，人们冒着生命危险爬上去。

sentences.en: But I wanted to see what it was like to ride it into Juarez, to try to migrate on this train.
sentences.zh: 但我很想看看乘坐它进入华雷斯城是什么感觉，尝试通过这列火车移民。

sentences.en: So I boarded it south of the city.
sentences.zh: 所以我从城市南边登上了它。

sentences.en: We're sitting here among construction material.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在建筑材料中间。

sentences.en: Looks like steel rebar.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是钢筋。

sentences.en: And I got into a car that was full of steel rebar and about 40 migrants who had been traveling, some of them, for four days.
sentences.zh: 我进入了一节装满钢筋的车厢，里面大约有40名移民，其中一些人已经旅行了四天。

sentences.en: The guys that I'm talking to said they've seen people killed when they've gotten off it and the train has run over them.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的人说，他们见过有人在下车时被火车碾死。

sentences.en: There's not much water.
sentences.zh: 那里几乎没有水。

sentences.en: There's barely any food.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有食物。

sentences.en: They're hungry.
sentences.zh: 他们很饿。

sentences.en: They're scared.
sentences.zh: 他们很害怕。

sentences.en: It gets so cold at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上冷得要命。

sentences.en: And during the day, it's unbearably hot.
sentences.zh: 白天又热得难以忍受。

sentences.en: And they're surrounded by metal.
sentences.zh: 而且他们被金属包围着。

sentences.en: So during the day, touching that scalding hot surface can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以白天触摸那滚烫的表面可能会很危险。

sentences.en: And at night, sleeping on it is really uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 而晚上睡在上面也非常不舒服。

sentences.en: It's that the truth is that the danger is that the danger is always with us.
sentences.zh: 事实是，危险总是伴随着我们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And one of the people I talked to was this 33-year-old named Jonathan Arevalo.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的人中有一位是33岁的乔纳森·阿雷瓦洛。

sentences.en: He's from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他来自委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: Jonathan said that danger's been with us since we left.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森说，自从我们离开后，危险就一直伴随着我们。

sentences.en: He has crossed the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 他穿越了达连地峡。

sentences.en: This treacherous jungle that was once considered impassable, but is now basically a highway for migrants to get here.
sentences.zh: 这片险恶的丛林曾经被认为是无法逾越的，但现在基本上成了移民到达这里的高速公路。

sentences.en: He spent days doing that.
sentences.zh: 他花了几天时间才走完。

sentences.en: His friends told me that they had to basically eat sugar for a couple of days because that's the only food that they had left.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友告诉我，他们基本上只能靠吃糖度过几天，因为那是他们剩下的唯一食物。

sentences.en: Jonathan is saying his choices were basically to stay in Venezuela and risk his life or leave and risk his life.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森说，他的选择基本上是留在委内瑞拉冒着生命危险，或者离开并冒着生命危险。

sentences.en: He didn't think he was going to survive in Venezuela, so he decided to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 他认为自己在委内瑞拉活不下去，所以决定试一试。

sentences.en: He's crossed into the United States several times already and been returned under Title 42.
sentences.zh: 他已经多次进入美国，并根据第42条被遣返。

sentences.en: He was expelled at a different part of the border from where he entered and then bussed to the south of the country.
sentences.zh: 他在进入边境的不同地点被驱逐，然后被送往该国南部。

sentences.en: So that's why he had to take a train all the way up north to try again.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么他不得不一路乘火车向北，试图再次尝试。

sentences.en: And he wanted to try one more time because he actually thinks it's going to get a lot harder when the measure lifts.
sentences.zh: 他想再试一次，因为他认为当这项措施解除后，情况会变得更加困难。

sentences.en: So Jonathan has heard basically that when the measure lifts, you really could just be deported.
sentences.zh: 所以乔纳森基本上听说，当措施解除后，你真的可能会被直接驱逐出境。

sentences.en: I think there's a couple of mixed messages happening here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里传达了一些相互矛盾的信息。

sentences.en: And so he had been on this train trying to make it one last time for several days.
sentences.zh: 所以他在火车上试图做最后一次尝试，已经好几天了。

sentences.en: And he basically said, I'm going to walk to the border if I can.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，如果可以的话，我会走到边境。

sentences.en: But when you're on the train, as soon as they catch a glimpse of the Juarez city limits, you know, a cheer will go up.
sentences.zh: 但当你坐在火车上时，一旦他们瞥见华雷斯城的边界，你知道，就会响起欢呼声。

sentences.en: People are also still really hopeful.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然充满希望。

sentences.en: And when they start to arrive to this city, you can feel the kind of spirit lift.
sentences.zh: 当他们开始到达这座城市时，你能感觉到那种精神振奋。

sentences.en: And people are looking at each other and they're saying, you know, we finally made it.
sentences.zh: 人们看着对方说，你知道，我们终于成功了。

sentences.en: Of course, for many of them, this is, they hope, the last leg of a very long journey.
sentences.zh: 当然，对他们中的许多人来说，他们希望这是漫长旅程的最后一站。

sentences.en: But I think they know and we know that there's no guarantee that this is really the end of it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们知道，我们也知道，这并不能保证这就是终点。

sentences.en: And the questions that the administration is asking itself and that we're all waiting to see is how long that takes, how much chaos unfolds, and whether the system gets overloaded.
sentences.zh: 政府在问自己的问题，也是我们都在等待观察的问题是，这需要多长时间，会发生多少混乱，以及系统是否会超负荷。

sentences.en: Well, Natalie, thank you for now.
sentences.zh: 好的，娜塔莉，先谢谢你。

sentences.en: And we will check back in with you once Title 42 is lifted and everything is different.
sentences.zh: 等第42条解除，一切都变得不同时，我们会再联系你。

sentences.en: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 430 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝我们帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天的 175 周年。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com/subscribe 获取特别优惠。

sentences.en: So, Natalie, when we talked to you on Thursday during that afternoon, things were looking to be at kind of a fever pitch.
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莉，当我们周四下午和你交谈时，情况似乎正处于白热化阶段。

sentences.en: There was this sudden wave of migrants at the border.
sentences.zh: 边境突然出现了一波移民潮。

sentences.en: The shelters on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国一侧的收容所

sentences.en: side were full.
sentences.zh: 已经满了。

sentences.en: Everyone had this question in their mind.
sentences.zh: 每个人心里都有一个疑问。

sentences.en: Is this going to basically break the United States system for processing migrants?
sentences.zh: 这会彻底压垮美国的移民处理系统吗？

sentences.en: So, what ended up happening once Title 42 was actually lifted?
sentences.zh: 那么，第 42 条款真正取消后，最终发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it didn't break the system.
sentences.zh: 嗯，系统并没有崩溃。

sentences.en: And it turned out that what we'd been seeing over the last few days, that was kind of the peak.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我们过去几天所看到的，那已经是某种程度上的高峰了。

sentences.en: And so, when the clock struck midnight Eastern time, I was sitting there watching the border.
sentences.zh: 所以，当东部时间午夜钟声敲响时，我正坐在那里观察边境。

sentences.en: I was looking at the Rio Grande and looking at this group of migrants waiting to try to get in.
sentences.zh: 我看着格兰德河，看着这群等待试图进入的移民。

sentences.en: It wasn't getting any bigger.
sentences.zh: 人数并没有增加。

sentences.en: We weren't seeing a big rush to the border.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到大批人涌向边境。

sentences.en: You know, for the whole week, we had kind of seen people walking with their kids and their belongings toward the border.
sentences.zh: 你知道，整个星期，我们都看到人们带着孩子和行李向边境走去。

sentences.en: We didn't see any of that that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们没看到任何那种情况。

sentences.en: I mean, it was really calm from where I was standing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从我站的地方看，真的很平静。

sentences.en: There was a lot of news media.
sentences.zh: 有很多新闻媒体。

sentences.en: There were a lot of cameras pointed at the border wall.
sentences.zh: 有很多摄像机对准了边境墙。

sentences.en: But what they were capturing was a pretty tranquil scene.
sentences.zh: 但他们捕捉到的却是一个相当宁静的场景。

sentences.en: How do you explain that, Natalie?
sentences.zh: 你如何解释这一点，娜塔莉？

sentences.en: That the worst-case scenario for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国最坏的情况

sentences.en: didn't quite materialize.
sentences.zh: 并没有真正发生。

sentences.en: It sounds like perhaps the president's message about the end of Title 42, don't come, the border isn't open, perhaps sunk in.
sentences.zh: 听起来总统关于第 42 条款结束的信息——不要来，边境没有开放——可能已经深入人心了。

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people on both sides of the border think that Biden and his administration were very clear that the new rules being put in place were not going to mean open doors at the border.
sentences.zh: 我认为边境两边的许多人都认为，拜登和他的政府非常明确地表示，实施的新规则并不意味着边境大门敞开。

sentences.en: And there's some sense that that message filtered down into the migrant WhatsApp groups, the Facebook groups, the chats that are constantly spreading that information.
sentences.zh: 而且人们有一种感觉，这个信息已经渗透到了移民的 WhatsApp 群组、Facebook 群组以及不断传播这些信息的聊天中。

sentences.en: And I was talking to migrants in Juarez who were telling me that, you know, they had heard this message from the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 我当时在华雷斯与移民交谈，他们告诉我，你知道，他们听到了拜登政府传达的这个信息。

sentences.en: Right,
sentences.zh: 没错，

sentences.en: because so much of the information that these migrants were receiving and spreading seemed to be that this wasn't a good time to come because of these new rules that you just referenced.
sentences.zh: 因为这些移民接收和传播的大部分信息似乎都是：由于你刚才提到的这些新规则，现在不是来的好时机。

sentences.en: And Natalie, we talked about these rules last week with our colleague Miriam Jordan.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我们上周和我们的同事米里亚姆·乔丹讨论过这些规则。

sentences.en: But just briefly remind us why these new rules would have this cumulative effect of making people pause, wait, not rush to the border.
sentences.zh: 但请简要提醒我们，为什么这些新规则会产生这种累积效应，让人们停下来、等待，而不是冲向边境。

sentences.en: So remember that under Title 42, there was a benefit for migrants.
sentences.zh: 记住，在第 42 条款下，移民是有利的。

sentences.en: There was a built-in incentive to cross the border illegally because if you cross the border illegally and got caught, you would probably be expelled immediately from the country.
sentences.zh: 非法越境有一种内在的激励，因为如果你非法越境被抓，你很可能会立即被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: But there was no black mark on your record.
sentences.zh: 但你的记录上不会有污点。

sentences.en: As soon as Title 42 lifts, that's over.
sentences.zh: 第 42 条款一取消，这种情况就结束了。

sentences.en: If you are caught crossing illegally, migrants know that you could be subject to criminal proceedings.
sentences.zh: 如果你被抓到非法越境，移民们知道你可能会面临刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: And most importantly, there's a five-year ban on reentering the United States.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，五年内禁止重新进入美国。

sentences.en: And so the migrants that I talked to are terrified of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我交谈过的移民对此感到恐惧。

sentences.en: This is the last thing that they want.
sentences.zh: 这是他们最不想要的结果。

sentences.en: And it's really on their minds, this notion that they wouldn't be able to try to come back in if this didn't work.
sentences.zh: 这确实在他们的脑海中挥之不去，这种如果行不通就无法再尝试进入的想法。

sentences.en: And the other issue that they're talking about is this new set of rules that makes it really hard to qualify for asylum,
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的另一个问题是这套新规则，它使得获得庇护变得非常困难，

sentences.en: which is this legal status that gives you protection from persecution in your home country.
sentences.zh: 这是一种法律地位，可以让你免受原籍国的迫害。

sentences.en: If migrants tried to claim asylum under these new restrictions Biden put in place,
sentences.zh: 如果移民试图根据拜登实施的这些新限制申请庇护，

sentences.en: you have to prove that you requested and were rejected for asylum in Mexico or another country that you passed through on the way to the United States.
sentences.zh: 你必须证明你在前往美国的途中经过墨西哥或其他国家时，曾申请过庇护但被拒绝。

sentences.en: There were some exceptions baked into these new rules,
sentences.zh: 这些新规则中包含了一些例外情况，

sentences.en: but all of the migrants that I talked to felt that these new rules made it essentially impossible for many of them to qualify for this kind of protected status.
sentences.zh: 但我交谈过的所有移民都觉得，这些新规则使得他们中的许多人基本上不可能获得这种受保护的身份。

sentences.en: So, you know, the overwhelming sense or the fear really was that the new system being put in place was bad.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，压倒性的感觉或恐惧确实是，正在实施的新系统很糟糕。

sentences.en: Right, which is exactly what the president and those around him hoped would be the message that reached these migrants.
sentences.zh: 没错，这正是总统及其周围的人希望传达给这些移民的信息。

sentences.en: And as you have just explained, Natalie, it seemed it did reach them.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才解释的那样，娜塔莉，看来它确实传达到了。

sentences.en: And it resulted in the averting of a momentary surge, perhaps even a crisis at the border over the past few days when this three-year-old emergency rule came to an end.
sentences.zh: 这导致在过去几天这个为期三年的紧急规则结束时，避免了一场短暂的激增，甚至可能是一场边境危机。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does seem that that may have happened, at least in the short term.
sentences.zh: 是的，看起来确实发生了这种情况，至少在短期内是这样。

sentences.en: But honestly, the border is an extremely dynamic place and people are making decisions based on information that changes daily.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，边境是一个极其动态的地方，人们根据每天都在变化的信息做出决定。

sentences.en: And, you know, the slightest sign that this new system actually isn't so bad that people are getting in, when migrants start getting those messages,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，任何一点迹象表明这个新系统其实没那么糟糕，人们正在进入，当移民开始收到这些信息时，

sentences.en: that is going to change their decision.
sentences.zh: 那将改变他们的决定。

sentences.en: That is going to impact the flows.
sentences.zh: 那将影响人流。

sentences.en: People are not static for long.
sentences.zh: 人们不会长期保持静止。

sentences.en: They are in wait-and-see mode for now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在处于观望模式。

sentences.en: But that can change really quickly.
sentences.zh: 但这可能会很快改变。

sentences.en: Well, so what do we know about that, Natalie?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这一点我们知道些什么，娜塔莉？

sentences.en: Specifically, what do we know about the people that you saw crossing into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，关于你上周晚些时候看到进入美国的那些人，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: late last week?
sentences.zh: 他们最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: What ended up happening to them?
sentences.zh: 对于其他人来说，这可能是什么信号，表明现在实际上是尝试进入美国的好时机还是坏时机？

sentences.en: And what kind of signal might that be to everyone else about whether this is, in fact, a good or bad moment to try to come into the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还不知道。

sentences.en: Well, we don't really know yet.
sentences.zh: 没有太多信息。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of information.
sentences.zh: 但这是移民们正在观察的，也是所有人都在观察的。

sentences.en: But here's what migrants are watching and really what everybody's watching.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府在实施其自身政策方面会有多成功？

sentences.en: How successful is the Biden administration going to be at implementing its own policy?
sentences.zh: 本质上，问题在于，拜登政府能够多快地驱逐大量人口？

sentences.en: And essentially, the question is, how quickly is the Biden administration going to be able to deport large numbers of people?
sentences.zh: 如果拜登政府能迅速驱逐大量移民，那将传达出这不是越境的好时机，现在仍然是越境的坏时机，

sentences.en: If the Biden administration can quickly deport large numbers of migrants, that is going to send the message that it is not a good time to cross, it remains a bad time to cross,
sentences.zh: 移民可能会坐下来等待。

sentences.en: and migrants may sit back and wait.
sentences.zh: 但拜登政府能否非常迅速且高效地驱逐大量人口并不是肯定的。

sentences.en: But it's not a sure thing that the Biden administration will be able to deport large numbers of people very quickly and efficiently.
sentences.zh: 从后勤上讲，这很难做到。

sentences.en: It's logistically difficult to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果政府做不到这一点，

sentences.en: And if the administration doesn't do that,
sentences.zh: 我们将看到的，也是移民们将看到的是，人们被允许进入该国，并收到一份在移民法官面前出庭的通知，

sentences.en: what we're going to see and what migrants will see is people being let into the country with a notice to appear before an immigration judge,
sentences.zh: 基本上是被允许合法地留在该国生活，至少在等待听证会期间的一段时间内。

sentences.en: basically being allowed to stay and live in the country legally, at least for some period of time while they wait for a hearing.
sentences.zh: 例如，儿童肯定会被允许进入等待，家庭很可能会被允许进入等待。

sentences.en: Children, for example, will definitely be let in to wait, families will very likely be let in to wait.
sentences.zh: 如果大量人员被允许进入等待，那将向边境的人们传达一个信息：你知道吗，至少在一段时间内，

sentences.en: And if large numbers are being let in to wait, that is going to send a message to people at the border that, you know what, there is a chance that at least for some period of time,
sentences.zh: 你是有机会进入美国的。

sentences.en: you could get into the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以现在尝试也许并不那么糟糕。

sentences.en: So maybe it isn't so bad to try right now.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，在这种动态的情况下，移民们正在寻找任何迹象，表明其实现在也许是去边境的好时机，

sentences.en: So you're saying that in this dynamic situation where migrants are looking for any sign that actually maybe it is a good time to go to the border,
sentences.zh: 即使是未能执行这些可怕的新政策，最终也可能破坏拜登政府旨在取代第 42 条款的整个计划。

sentences.en: even a failure to execute these scary new policies might end up undermining this entire program designed to replace Title 42 for the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 哦，那肯定会。

sentences.en: Oh, it definitely would.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，新系统还面临另一个威胁，那就是拜登的新政策正面临一系列法律挑战。

sentences.en: And on top of that, there's this other threat to the new system, which is that Biden's new policies are facing a bunch of legal challenges.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我们这件事。

sentences.en: So tell us about this.
sentences.zh: 政府正面临对其新政策的几项法律挑战。

sentences.en: So the administration is facing a couple of legal challenges to its new policies.
sentences.zh: 第一个法律挑战来自佛罗里达州，它真正针对的是拜登政府让移民离开拘留所进入美国的方式。

sentences.en: The first legal challenge comes from Florida, and it really targets the way the Biden administration is letting migrants out of custody and into the United States.
sentences.zh: 其论点是，这是一种非法的方式，给当地政府和州内的系统带来了不应有的负担。

sentences.en: The argument is that this is happening in an unlawful way that puts an undue burden on the local government and the systems in the state.
sentences.zh: 如果诉讼有效，如果它成功了，这对政府来说不会是好事。

sentences.en: If the lawsuit works, if it's successful, that wouldn't be great for the administration.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不清楚那件事会发生什么。

sentences.en: But it's not really clear what's going to happen with that one.
sentences.zh: 专家们说，一个潜在的更大威胁是美国公民自由联盟提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: A potentially bigger threat, experts are saying, is a lawsuit filed by the American Civil Liberties Union.
sentences.zh: 基本上，美国公民自由联盟和其他人在诉讼中说的是，要求人们在另一个国家申请庇护并被拒绝才能在美国获得庇护，这是不公平的，也是违反美国法律的。

sentences.en: And basically what the ACLU and others are saying in that suit is that it's not fair and it's a violation of U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: law to require people to apply for and get rejected for asylum in another country in order to get it in the United States.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，你可能会看到更多人进入，这将强化等待中的移民的信息，即现在是尝试越境的好时机。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 所以随时，

sentences.en: Then again, you could see more people getting in, and that would reinforce the message to migrants waiting that now is a good time to try to cross.
sentences.zh: 法官可能会让整个系统陷入混乱，白宫一直在发出的不要来的所有信号都可能被颠倒过来，拜登政府将回到原点。

sentences.en: So at any moment,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种真正的可能性。

sentences.en: a judge could just throw this entire system into chaos and all these signals that the White House has been sending not to come could be turned on their head and the Biden administration will be back to square one.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，它确实说明了我们现在在边境所处的时刻，那就是不确定性。

sentences.en: That's a real possibility, I think.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And, you know, it really speaks to this moment that we're in at the border right now, which is just uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 有很多人在墨西哥等待，

sentences.en: We really don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 政府正在观察这在法庭上如何发展，以及他们执行自己新规则的能力如何。

sentences.en: There are a lot of people waiting in Mexico,
sentences.zh: 事情真的处于变动之中。

sentences.en: and there's an administration that is looking at how this is playing out in the courts and how well they're able to execute their own new rules.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我很好奇。

sentences.en: And things are really in flux.
sentences.zh: 你知道你上周遇到的所有人发生了什么吗，特别是在“野兽”号上，那辆许多人为了试图到达边境而乘坐的可怕火车？

sentences.en: Nelly, I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you know what happened to all the people that you met last week, especially on The Beast, that terrifying train that so many of them take to try to get to the border?
sentences.zh: 还记得我在火车上遇到的那个 33 岁的委内瑞拉人乔纳森·阿雷瓦洛吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 他一直在给我发语音备忘录。

sentences.en: So remember Jonathan Arevalo, the 33-year-old Venezuelan guy that I met on the train?
sentences.zh: 从那天起我们一直保持联系。

sentences.en: He's been sending me voice memos.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，你知道，他非常渴望在第 42 条款结束前尝试非法越境。

sentences.en: We've been keeping in touch since that day.
sentences.zh: 他认为这会给他更好的成功机会。

sentences.en: And he told me that, you know, he was desperate to try to cross illegally before the end of Title 42.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我那天他是怎么下火车的，基本上整天整夜都在走路。

sentences.en: He thought that would give him a better chance of making it in.
sentences.zh: 他停下来快速吃了一口饭，然后直接去了边境。

sentences.en: And he told me how he got off the train that day, and he basically spent all day and night walking.
sentences.zh: 但当他到达那里时，他说，他们遇到了卡特尔的人。

sentences.en: He stopped for a quick bite to eat and then went straight to the border.
sentences.zh: 他说卡特尔成员正在攻击他周围的许多人。

sentences.en: But when he got there, he said, they ran into people from the cartel.
sentences.zh: 他不知道这些卡特尔成员在找什么。

sentences.en: He said that cartel members were attacking a lot of the people around him.
sentences.zh: 也许是为了抢劫他们。

sentences.en: He doesn't know what these cartel members were looking for.
sentences.zh: 也许是为了绑架他们。

sentences.en: Maybe it was to rob them.
sentences.zh: 但他一路上见识了足够的危险，知道要回头。

sentences.en: Maybe it was to kidnap them.
sentences.zh: 所以他放弃了试图进入的任务，回到了华雷斯，找了个地方睡觉。

sentences.en: But he's seen enough danger along the way that he knew to turn back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在一家水果店工作。

sentences.en: So he abandoned that mission of trying to get in and went back to Juarez, found a place to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他想赚点钱，现在正在等待时机。

sentences.en: You know, he's working at a fruit store.
sentences.zh: 他说他每天都在看信息。

sentences.en: He's trying to make a little money, and he's now waiting it out.
sentences.zh: 他正在观察这项新政策会发生什么。

sentences.en: He said he's looking at information every day.
sentences.zh: 他现在很有耐心。

sentences.en: He is looking to see what happens with this new policy.
sentences.zh: 但我的感觉是，这种耐心不会持续太久。

sentences.en: He's being patient right now.
sentences.zh: 他说，一旦他得到任何人们正在进入的迹象，他就会尝试。

sentences.en: But my sense is that patience isn't going to last long.
sentences.zh: 他会越过边境并试一试。

sentences.en: He said that as soon as he gets any sign that people are getting in, he's going to try.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这只是让你有一种感觉。

sentences.en: He will cross the border and give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这家伙穿过了一片丛林。

sentences.en: And, you know, it just gives you a sense.
sentences.zh: 他经历了好几个国家，几个月的旅行。

sentences.en: I mean, this guy has been through a jungle.
sentences.zh: 做过所有这些事情的人不会那么容易放弃。

sentences.en: He's been through several countries, several months of travel.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有成千上万像乔纳森这样的人紧随其后。

sentences.en: People who have done all of that aren't going to give up that easily.
sentences.zh: 穿过这片丛林——达连地峡——来到这里的人数仍然徘徊在创纪录的高位附近。

sentences.en: And, you know, there are tens of thousands of people just like Jonathan that are following close behind.
sentences.zh: 驱动人们前往美国边境的力量比任何单一政策所能控制的都要大。

sentences.en: The numbers of people that are going through this jungle, the Darien Gap, to get here, they are still hovering near record highs.
sentences.zh: 那是饥饿和贫困。

sentences.en: The forces that are driving people to the United States border are bigger than any one policy can control.
sentences.zh: 那是经济流离失所。

sentences.en: It's hunger and poverty.
sentences.zh: 那是暴力。

sentences.en: It's economic displacement.
sentences.zh: 而这些事情并没有改变。

sentences.en: It's violence.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是目前对移民和拜登政府来说真正的问题所在。

sentences.en: And those things haven't changed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有人们把目光锁定在边境，只是为了看看会发生什么，因为他们绝望了。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's the real issue right now, both for migrants and for the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 对于拜登政府来说，那里没有太多的回旋余地。

sentences.en: I mean, you have people that have their eyes trained on the border to just see what's going to happen because they are desperate.
sentences.zh: 如果这项政策没有按照他们想要的方式运作，

sentences.en: And for the Biden administration, there's not a lot of leeway there.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会看到乔纳森和所有已经遭受了这么多苦难和牺牲的人，再迈出一步去尝试测试这个系统。

sentences.en: If this policy doesn't work out the way they want it to,
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，一切都难说了。

sentences.en: they could see Jonathan and all of the other people that have suffered and sacrificed so much already just take one more step to try to test this system.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And if that happens, all bets are off.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Natalie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那两位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: A special counsel appointed under President Trump to reexamine how the government investigated ties between Trump and Russia issued a final report on Monday that heavily criticized both the FBI and the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统任期内任命的一位特别检察官，负责重新审查政府调查特朗普与俄罗斯之间联系的过程，该检察官周一发布了一份最终报告，严厉批评了联邦调查局和司法部。

sentences.en: The report, overseen by John Durham, found that agents rushed into the investigation of Trump and that their handling of the probe was, quote, seriously deficient.
sentences.zh: 这份由约翰·达勒姆监督的报告发现，特工们在调查特朗普时操之过急，且他们处理调查的方式被形容为“严重失职”。

sentences.en: But Durham's four-year investigation produced little new information, sent no one to prison,
sentences.zh: 但达勒姆历时四年的调查几乎没有提供什么新信息，也没有将任何人送进监狱，

sentences.en: and failed to deliver the kind of embarrassing revelations that both Trump and his allies had promised that it would.
sentences.zh: 更未能揭露出特朗普及其盟友此前承诺的那种令人尴尬的内幕。

sentences.en: And a man armed with a baseball bat entered a district office of Congressman Jerry Connolly of Virginia on Monday morning and attacked two of his staff members.
sentences.zh: 周一上午，一名手持棒球棍的男子闯入了弗吉尼亚州国会议员杰里·康诺利的地区办公室，并袭击了两名工作人员。

sentences.en: The motive of the attacker, who is now in custody, remains unclear, but the incident comes amid a sharp rise in threats against members of Congress,
sentences.zh: 这名袭击者目前已被拘留，其动机尚不明确，但此次事件发生之际，针对国会议员的威胁正急剧增加，

sentences.en: including a violent attack last fall on the husband of former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 其中包括去年秋天针对前众议院议长南希·佩洛西丈夫的暴力袭击事件。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto, Claire Tennisgetter, Nina Feldman, and Shannon Lynn.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托、克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特、尼娜·费尔德曼和香农·林恩制作。

sentences.zh: 由 M.J. 编辑，

sentences.zh: 戴维斯·林恩和帕特里夏·威伦斯参与编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢莎拉·克尔、玛丽亚·阿比-哈比卜、索米亚·卡拉·曼格拉、凯伦·扎雷克、米里亚姆·乔丹和埃德加·桑多瓦尔。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台收听。
